player_prompt.intro: You are Player {player_id} in a {max_rounds} round game of Kuhn Poker.
player_prompt.deck_rule: - Kuhn Poker uses a 3-card deck with J, Q, K (J lowest, K highest)
player_prompt.ante_rule: - Each player antes {ante} chip and receives 1 card each round (note that the cards are dealt without replacement, so you cannot have the same card as your opponent).
player_prompt.win_rule: - The player with the most chips after all rounds wins
player_prompt.check: - '[check]': Pass without betting (only if no bet is on the table)
player_prompt.bet: - '[bet]': Add 1 chip to the pot (only if no bet is on the table)
player_prompt.call: - '[call]': Match an opponent's bet by adding 1 chip to the pot
player_prompt.fold: - '[fold]': Surrender your hand and let your opponent win the pot

init_round.round_start: ### Starting round {current_round} out of {max_rounds} rounds. Your card is: '{player_card}'

outcome.winner_player0: Player 0 won by having more chips at the end of all {max_rounds} rounds.
outcome.winner_player1: Player 1 won by having more chips at the end of all {max_rounds} rounds.
